2609.09974.title: Towards Stress-Aware Sentence-Level Filipino G2P With Weakly-Supervised ByT5 Fine-Tuning
2609.09974.paper_summary: Grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P) refers to the task of converting a sequence of graphemes to a corresponding sequence of phonemes. While Filipino G2P is fairly straightforward due to its shallow orthography, the inclusion of prosodic features such as stress adds a layer of complexity that requires sentence-level context instead of single-word inputs. However, sentence-level data for Filipino typically do not include phoneme transcriptions, posing a challenge for training G2P models. As such, we investigate how to obtain sentence-level phoneme data for Filipino using available data and compare the resulting models with multilingual word-level G2P as well as measure how accurately they predict stress marker position for Filipino. We propose fine-tuning a ByT5-based model, pre-trained on multilingual word-level G2P data, on three sentence-level G2P datasets annotated with an LLM-assisted pipeline guided by data from Wiktionary. This approach produces models that perform well on the G2P task, achieving at best around 0.54% PER and 2.50% CER, a significant decrease compared to base model PER at around 19.74%, on a manually-corrected test set. The model is able to correctly classify most of the main stress classes in Filipino, but struggles particularly with malumi words. We show that a ByT5-based model performs well at sentence-level Filipino G2P and offers strong potential for Filipino homograph disambiguation.
2609.09974.paper_summary_zh: 字母到音素轉換（G2P）是指將一系列字母轉換為相應的一系列音素的任務。雖然菲律賓語的 G2P 相對簡單，因為它的正字法較淺，但加入如重音等韻律特徵則增加了一層複雜性，這需要句子層級的上下文，而不是單字輸入。然而，菲律賓語的句子層級數據通常不包括音素轉錄，這對訓練 G2P 模型造成了挑戰。因此，我們研究如何利用可用數據獲取菲律賓語的句子層級音素數據，並將生成的模型與多語言單詞層級 G2P 進行比較，還測量它們對菲律賓語重音標記位置的預測準確性。我們提出對一個基於 ByT5 的模型進行微調，該模型在多語言單詞層級 G2P 數據上進行了預訓練，並在三個句子層級的 G2P 數據集上進行訓練，這些數據集是通過一個由維基詞典數據指導的 LLM 輔助管道進行標註的。這種方法產生的模型在 G2P 任務上表現良好，在手動校正的測試集上，最佳的字錯誤率（PER）約為 0.54% 和字符錯誤率（CER）約為 2.50%，相比於基礎模型的 PER 約為 19.74%，有顯著下降。該模型能夠正確分類大多數菲律賓語的主要重音類別，但在處理 malumi 單詞時特別困難。我們顯示基於 ByT5 的模型在句子層級的菲律賓語 G2P 上表現良好，並對菲律賓語同形異義詞消歧具有強大的潛力。
